name: count
title: Count
summary: A small number badge next to a label, a tab or a heading.
description: Number badge: a count next to a label, tab, chip or heading. Tabular numbers, one line, never shrinks: a huge number widens the badge instead of wrapping. plain is coloured text; boxed sits in a small inset box. Inside a selected chip, tab or segment it takes the selected look by itself.

anatomy.description: Holds the number as text ("12", "+3", "12,480"). Format it before passing it in.

variant.description: plain: ink-2 text in the surrounding size. boxed: 20px box, radius.chip, inset fill with a hairline, 11px/500 ink-2.

size.description: md: plain in the surrounding size, boxed 20px. sm: plain 12px (text.xs), boxed an 18px box.

selected.description: The selected look of a boxed count (field fill, ink); a plain count stays ink-2, the quieter one beside its selected label. Applied automatically inside an element with data-state="checked", aria-selected="true", aria-checked="true" or aria-pressed="true".

notes: The number is real text and is read with its label. When the label alone does not say what is counted, give the count a visually hidden suffix ("12 unread") or put the meaning in the label.
Never truncate a number; the badge grows instead.
A signed value ("+2", "-1") keeps its sign order on a right-to-left page: the badge is a left-to-right island (direction: ltr, unicode-bidi: isolate).

motion: selected: fill and colour cross-fade over duration.base, ease (it follows the chip or tab that is selected)
